review_note:
🔴 This is an **example** baseline, pinning the Read definition from this repo's own tests/fake_cli.py — it is this repo's own code, and anyone who clones it can reproduce this hash byte-for-byte.

It is **not** any real vendor CLI's definition. To gate a real CLI with this, capture one against your own binary with tests/capture_tool_baseline.py, then review every field **yourself** before flipping review_status to REVIEWED — only a human can do that step, so this repo does not require it to be REVIEWED, only that this status be read aloud on every run.

Why no real-CLI baseline ships with the package: ① that would redistribute the vendor's definition text; ② baselines are version-bound — someone else's CLI version differs from yours, and shipping one would only lead them to trust a value that is invalid for them.
